seo.title: Educational & LMS Website Development | CloudTopia
seo.description: LMS and course website development with enrollment, lessons, quizzes, and certificates — bilingual and fully yours. Book a free consultation and live demo.

hero.subtitle: We build education websites and learning platforms where students enroll, watch lessons, take quizzes, track progress, and earn certificates — all on a system you fully own. Built bilingual in Arabic and English, with WhatsApp support and a working demo before you commit.

features.heading: A learning platform built around how you actually teach

items.title: Enrollment and student accounts
items.description: Self-serve sign-up, course catalogs, cohort or open enrollment, and student dashboards that show exactly what each learner has started, finished, and has left to do.

items.title: Lessons, quizzes and certificates
items.description: Structured courses with video and document lessons, drip scheduling, graded quizzes and assignments, and auto-issued completion certificates learners can download.

items.title: Instructor and admin control
items.description: Role-based access so instructors manage their own content and grading while admins oversee enrollments, reporting, and revenue from a single back office.

items.title: Payments and access rules
items.description: Sell courses, bundles, or subscriptions through local and international gateways, with content locked until purchase, enrollment, or prerequisite completion.

faqs.question: Do you build on an existing LMS or code it from scratch?
faqs.answer: Both — we recommend whichever fits your needs and budget. We can build on proven platforms like Moodle, LearnDash, or Tutor LMS, or develop a fully custom learning system when your courses and rules are too specific for an off-the-shelf tool. Either way you own the result, and we show you a live demo before you commit.

faqs.question: Can students pay for courses and get access automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate local and international payment gateways so learners can buy a single course, a bundle, or a recurring subscription, and access unlocks the moment payment clears. You can also offer free courses, coupons, and manual enrollment for sponsored or corporate students.

faqs.question: Will the platform work in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. We deliver the interface, course content structure, emails, and certificates bilingually with full right-to-left support for Arabic. Students get a native experience in their language, and you can publish each course in one or both languages.

faqs.question: Can it handle video lessons, quizzes, and certificates?
faqs.answer: Those are core to every learning platform we build. We set up secure video hosting, downloadable resources, drip-scheduled lessons, graded quizzes and assignments, and certificates that generate automatically when a learner completes a course. Progress tracking keeps both students and instructors informed.

faqs.question: Do we own the platform and our student data after launch?
faqs.answer: Completely. You receive the source code, the database with all your courses and student records, the hosting accounts, and the documentation. There is no per-student licence and no lock-in — your team can host it, extend it, and run it independently of us.
